### Pathway to Purpose: Is Your Life Out of Sync?
Author: Katie Brazelton
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/spiritual-life/pathway-to-purpose-is-your-life-out-of-sync-1332032.html
Passage: Job 7:6
Points:
- Painful disruptions and loss can plunge believers into grief, loneliness, and feelings of uselessness.
- Like Job, people in deep distress often feel their days slipping away in hopeless futility.
- Major life transitions frequently trigger disorienting questions about identity and calling.
- Lingering emptiness does not mean life lacks value or divine significance.
- God uses barren seasons to refine our desires and reveal His purposeful direction.
